note: Reference translation prepared by the course team: one possible solution, not the only correct answer.

strings.intro.narration.arrival: Mid-Autumn night. {player_name} arrives at the night market and hears that Granny Wong's biggest rabbit lantern has vanished.
strings.intro.line.granny_greeting: You're here at last! Someone has stolen my rabbit lantern!
strings.intro.line.kit_joke: Granny, that rabbit's enormous. Unless it hopped back to the moon by itself!
strings.intro.choice.follow: Follow the man in the tall hat
strings.intro.ending.a: At the end of the street you find the Riddle King: he only borrowed the lantern for a riddle contest!
strings.intro.ending.b: The neighbours all talk at once. By the time you finish asking, the lantern is back on its stall.
strings.voice.line.granny_scold: Late again, you rascal! Hurry up and help me find that lantern.
strings.voice.line.kit_cheeky: Granny, your lantern's so pretty, whoever nicked it must have great taste!
strings.voice.ending.a: Kit mumbles a sorry, and Granny Wong smiles and gives him a mooncake.
strings.voice.ending.b: Granny Wong chases you both three times round the night market.
strings.pun.line.riddle_intro: Ha! {player_name}, solve my riddle and the lantern is yours: 'With a heart it cannot hurry.' Which character?
strings.pun.ending.a: 'Wrong!' The Riddle King roars with laughter and hangs the lantern one level higher.
strings.pun.ending.b: 'Correct!' The Riddle King hands the lantern back with both hands.
strings.ui.hud.toast:
New clue!
{player_name} found some rabbit fur.
strings.ui.ending.a: You hold up the {item_name}, and a giant rabbit's shadow appears on the wall.
strings.ui.ending.b: You sit down with a mooncake. Someone shouts: '{player_name}, the rabbit's over here!'
